description: Envelopes to one device (inbox, §5.3) and to a pairing secret (§5.5): openDirect(outer, conversation key) → sender identity, device, type, or null. The inbox conversation key is NIP-44 between `recipientSecret` and outer.pubkey. Also: key-grant shapes, grantRole (receiver role when a grant from `sender` is acceptable, under `membership`), portable ops (signed inner op events carried by grants and snapshots), pairing codes and key packages.

keyPackages.name: two devices, one foreign delegation dropped
